description_en: Invoke DescribeCallList to perform a paged query of communication records created within a specified time range.
description_zh: 调用DescribeCallList分页查询时间范围内创建的通信信息
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-call-list --app-id testappid --start-ts 1615806196 --end-ts 1615892596 --channel-id 311 --user-id c906531af5f90000 --call-status OUT --order-by BAD_EXP_USER_COUNT_DESC --query-mode ALL --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCallList

parameters.help_en: Start Time of the query, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_ts

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query, expressed as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: end_ts

parameters.help_en:
Call status. Valid values:
- **IN**: In progress.
- **OUT**: Ended
parameters.help_zh:
通信状态。取值：
- **IN**：进行中。
- **OUT**：已结束
parameters.name: call_status

parameters.help_en:
Sorting field. Valid values:
- **BAD_EXP_USER_COUNT_DESC**: Sort by the number of users with poor experience in descending order.
- **BAD_EXP_USER_COUNT_ASC**: Sort by the number of users with poor experience in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。取值：
- **BAD_EXP_USER_COUNT_DESC**：按体验欠佳人数降序。
- **BAD_EXP_USER_COUNT_ASC**：按体验欠佳人数升序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
Query mode. Valid values:
- **ALL**: All calls.
- **FOLLOW**: Followed calls
parameters.help_zh:
查询模式。取值：
- **ALL**：全部通话。
- **FOLLOW**：关注通话
parameters.name: query_mode

parameters.help_en: Page number. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: Quantity per page, minimum value is 1, maximum value is 200
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量，最小1， 最大200
parameters.name: page_size
